text.tspan: Weekly Report
To:Tom Ulaszek
From:Marty Pennock
Subject:Status Report
Date:June 18, 1992
Accomplishments
1.Faxed Bob Brodie numbers to obtain Genie Account for myself and personal developer
roundtable account for product engineering.
2.Printed copy of corrected Falcon030 Expansion connector drawing and turned in for review.
3.Gave Jerry Smith copies of all my GEM files to use in his documents.
4.Finished text edits of Sparrow Service Guide Chapter 2.
5.Started layout of Sparrow Service Guide in PageStream.
6.Received and installed coprocessor in ABC386DXII system.
7.Completed layout of Sparrow Service Guide Chapter 1 in PageStream.
8.Got partial ECO History for MEGA ST
Addendum from MANMAN.
9.Broke apart and finished layout of Sparrow Service Guide Chapter two sections one and
two.
10.Began installation of network hardware and software on TT030.
11.Got 2MB floppy and AJAX for home TT030.
12.Completed Sparrow Service Guide Chapter 2 section 3 layout.
Plans
1.Produce Service Guides for STBook, Portfolio, 2600, Falcon040, and 7800 products.
2.Finish Sparrow Service Guide Chapters 2 and 3 with all diagnostic edits.
3.Finish Sparrow Service Guide Chapter 4 when Mechanical information code for field is
available.
